title: Guarantee read-only access and safe SQLite/WAL snapshotting
description: Adapters never write to source directories; SQLite/WAL sources are read through a safe snapshot copy. Done when: tests prove no source mutation and a WAL database reads correctly through the snapshot path.

comments.author: home
comments.text: wal_snapshot.feature implemented and un-@wip: src/snapshot.rs snapshots a SQLite source through a read-only connection with the online backup API (snapshot_sqlite); BDD proves the db+WAL digests are unchanged by the read (digest_files), the snapshot reflects rows present at snapshot time, and the live writer keeps appending without interference. rusqlite 0.40 (bundled + backup) added. All gates green: 18 features / 80 scenarios BDD, fmt, clippy -D warnings, doc, doctests, spec coverage.

right_now_summary: SQLite/WAL reads use safe snapshots, and tests confirm source files stay unchanged.
